worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 150,010.00 + taxable interest 30,000.00 = 180,010.00. Federal taxable income = 180,010.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 162,260.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040ME, single: line 14 federal AGI 180,010.00. Schedule 1A line 1 (PDF p.7) other-state municipal bond interest 0.00; Schedule 1A total = line 15a 0.00. Schedule 1S line 3 (PDF p.7) taxable Social Security 0.00 + railroad retirement 0.00 = 0.00. Schedule 1S line 4 pension income deduction 0.00 (no eligible pension income). Schedule 1S line 27 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = line 15b 0.00. Line 16 Maine AGI = 180,010.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 180,010.00. Line 17 (person 0 born 1955-03-03 is 70 at December 31, 2025; 1 box(es)): Worksheet for Standard/Itemized Deductions (PDF p.5): line 1 180,010.00; line 2 100,000.00; line 3 80,010.00; line 4 75,000.00; line 5 1.0000. Projection: base 15,000.00 less 0.2 x 80,010.00 = 16,002.00 (limited to 15,000.00) = 0.00; the additional 65-or-over amount 1 x 2,000.00 is removed in full above the threshold, so line 17 = 0.00. The form reduces the whole chart amount by the share: line 6 17,000.00, line 7 17,000.00, line 8 0.00; equal to the projection above the top of the band. Line 13 = 1; line 18 exemption = 1 x 5,150.00 = 5,150.00 (Maine AGI not over 333,450.00). Line 19 taxable income = 180,010.00 - 0.00 - 5,150.00 = 174,860.00. Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (26,800.00 - 0.00) = 1,554.40 + 6.75% x (63,450.00 - 26,800.00) = 2,473.875 + 7.15% x (174,860.00 - 63,450.00) = 7,965.815 = 11,994.09. The printed schedule (PDF p.13) with its whole-dollar constant 4,028.00 gives 11,993.82; expected keeps the bracket tax computed in full. Line 23 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 24 Maine income tax 11,994.09.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
